metadata.description: Kenya's public debt composition by year (external vs domestic), with GDP and debt-to-GDP ratio
metadata.notes: 2013-2021 were round hundreds of billions attributed to CBK; no CBK table produces that. They are now CBK's own December readings from https://www.centralbank.go.ke/public-debt/ (monthly domestic/external/total, 1999-2021), parsed by seeding/domains/national_debt/cbk_web_tables.py and accepted only where CBK's identity domestic + external = total holds. The replaced 2013 figure was 3,100Bn against CBK's 2,111.6Bn — 46.8% too high, with the error shrinking toward the present: a series extrapolated backwards. 2022-2025 keep the CBK Statistical Bulletin values applied by the 2026-08-29 correction; CBK's HTML table stops at 2021.
